name: Okamura Foods Co.,Ltd.
summary: Okamura Foods Co., Ltd. cultivates, processes and distributes salmon trout for Japanese and overseas markets. Its range also includes processed seafood such as salmon roe, salted salmon roe, herring roe, raw salmon for sushi and cooked fish, and it wholesales marine products. Dating from 1971, it has its headquarters in Aomori, Japan.
